selectionEntries.name: Additional Copy Costs

modifiers.value: Additional Copy Costs is automatically managed by the listbuilder and should appear only once. Remove any extra Additional Copy Costs entries.

selectionEntries.comment: SOFT OTHER COPY COSTS: permanent required accounting entry. It applies the normal +20 Points surcharge to native non-Rare Other units beyond the selected Game Size's 1/2/3-copy allowance. Daemonkin uses a mode-aware refund ladder: a normal Master of Possession exempts Possessed from normal copy-cost counting, while a Master of Possession with Daemonic Jump Pack exempts Warp Talons instead. Because New Recruit does not reliably expose roster-scope association counts to this separate configuration entry, those refunds are driven by Master of Possession / Daemonic Jump Pack selection state and capped by the actual number of excess host copies. Shared Game System validation handles missing Additional Copy Costs and Legion configuration.

selectionEntries.comment: LOADOUT REV18: Alpha Legion-only Lernaean Terminators use the same three-role player-facing architecture as Chaos Terminators. Each model independently chooses Combi-weapon Terminator, Heavy Weapon Terminator, or Assault Terminator. The Combi-weapon branch adds Volkite Charger to the standard double/mixed Combi options; the Heavy Weapon branch offers Reaper Autocannon, Heavy Flamer, Conversion Beamer, Plasma Blaster, or Volkite Culverin; and every branch uses the Lernaean melee list of Power Weapon, Power Fist, Chainfist, or Lightning Claw. Assault Terminators select two independent melee weapons, so selecting Lightning Claw twice represents paired Lightning Claws without a separate Lightning Claws option. By project convention, both Lernaean Terminators may use identical roles and identical equipment despite the PDF's one-model replacement wording. Existing Alpha Legion visibility, Other copy-cost category, points, Heavy Armour, and wrong-Legion validation remain unchanged.

selectionEntries.name: Legionaries

modifiers.value: This unit has more than one Leader attached. It may have only one attached Leader. Remove or move one of the attached Leaders.

selectionEntries.comment: LOADOUT REV15: fixed five-model presentation compiled for listbuilder clarity. Chaos Champion has a mandatory Power Weapon / Power Fist / Daemon Hammer choice and a mandatory Bolt Pistol / Plasma Pistol choice; the player-facing Bolt Pistol label intentionally shortens the source Champion Bolt Pistol name. Legionary 2-3 share one two-model package choice: 2x Boltgun & Combat Knife or 2x Chainsword & Bolt Pistol. Those package buttons carry hidden semantic child items so one player-facing choice can still represent the separate underlying weapons. Legionary 4 and Legionary 5 each choose Special Weapon Legionary, Heavy Weapon Legionary, or Butcher Legionary. Special Weapon Legionaries retain Combat Knife and choose Meltagun / Plasmagun / Flamer; Heavy Weapon Legionaries retain Combat Knife and choose Autocannon / Heavy Bolter / Lascannon / Missile Launcher / Reaper Chaincannon; Butcher Legionaries retain Combat Knife and carry Heavy Chain Axe. The uncommon source-legal fallback where Legionary 4 or 5 remains a normal Boltgun/Combat Knife model is intentionally not given its own button under the companion-listbuilder presentation policy. Chaos Influence is an optional +10 choice between Khornate Bloodlust, Tzeentian Sorcery, Nurglite Contagion, and Slaaneshi Grace. Replenished Ranks zeroes both the root Legionaries cost and any selected Chaos Influence descendant cost when this unit is the Chaos Apothecary's host.

selectionEntries.comment: LOADOUT REV16: fixed ten-model Cultists presentation. Cultist Champion is shown with Bolt Pistol and Assault Weapon; Cultists 2-9 are aggregated as 8x Assault Weapon and 8x Autopistol. Cultist 10 chooses between the normal Assault Weapon & Autopistol package and Heavy Stubber for +10 Points. The normal package uses hidden semantic child items for Assault Weapon and Autopistol so the catalogue retains the underlying equipment while presenting one clean player-facing choice. Frag Grenades and Krak Grenades remain independent +10 Paid Wargear choices. Existing Chaos Lord / Chaos Sorcerer host eligibility and the standard single-attached-Leader validation remain unchanged.

selectionEntries.name: Chaos Terminators

categoryLinks.name: Counts Toward Other Soft Copy Cost

selectionEntries.comment: LOADOUT REV17: the two-model Chaos Terminator unit is presented as two explicit independent model records because its battlefield roles differ substantially despite the PDF expressing them through overlapping replacement clauses. Each model chooses one of three player-facing roles: Combi-weapon Terminator, Heavy Weapon Terminator, or Assault Terminator. Combi-weapon Terminators select one melee weapon plus one Combi package; the Combi packages use a single visible choice with hidden semantic child items, and Combi-Melta & Combi-Bolter costs +10. Heavy Weapon Terminators select one melee weapon plus Reaper Autocannon or Heavy Flamer. Assault Terminators select two independent melee weapons; choosing Lightning Claw in both lists represents paired Lightning Claws without a separate Lightning Claws option. By project convention, both Terminators may use identical roles and identical loadouts even where the PDF's one-model replacement language would ordinarily restrict that. Cyclone Missiles remains a single +20 Paid Wargear choice at unit level because the physical model makes its bearer unambiguous during play.

selectionEntries.comment:
LOADOUT REV14: Chosen are 3-5 models at 40 Points per model. Pack your lunch? defaults to the normal manual builder. The manual branch exposes Chosen 1-3 as fixed model headers and optional Chosen 4-5 at +40 Points each. Chosen 1-2 include the source paid Combi-Bolter replacement packages in their ranged list; Chosen 3-5 do not. Every model independently selects one ranged and one melee weapon. By project convention, Lightning Claw is additionally offered in every ranged list, allowing the paired-claw state by selecting Lightning Claw in both lists and intentionally ignoring the PDF's one-model restriction because it does not alter the unit's total damage budget for project purposes. catalogue.comment:
LAYER 0.1 — LEGIONS AND UNIT SELECTION
Built the Chaos Space Marines roster foundation from the Universal Unit Skeleton and PDF before any loadout work. Legion is a required Configuration selector with Black Legion, Iron Warriors, Night Lords, and Alpha Legion; Black Legion is the default. Legion-exclusive units use safe-hide presentation and constructive wrong-Legion errors. The generic Chaos Lord and Terminator Chaos Lord are intentionally compiled as four Legion-specific player-facing units each, all preserving their shared source profile/cost while carrying the exact Chaos Lord abilities of the selected Legion. Terminator Warsmith also receives the Iron Warriors Chaos Lord abilities because its source profile has Champion of Chaos. All native unit names, minimum legal points costs, Leader/Troop/Other, Rare, Infantry/Vehicle/Monster, Leader Capacity, and ACC semantics are present. Attachments and all loadout/configuration details are intentionally deferred to later passes.

LAYER 0.2 — LEGION PRESENTATION REV2
Retargeted to Game System Rev15. Legion-specific units now use their Legion as the primary Army List presentation category: Black Legion, Iron Warriors, Night Lords, or Alpha Legion. Their original Leader/Other and Infantry/Vehicle/Rare/counting categories remain attached as secondary semantic tags. Generic Chaos Space Marines units remain under Leader, Troop, and Other. Legion visibility, safe-hide behavior, constructive wrong-Legion errors, ACC, and points are unchanged.

LAYER 0.3 — ARMY-LEVEL RULES REV3
Completed the non-loadout army-construction pass. Added required Leader attachments for all four Legion-specific Chaos Lords, Chaos Sorcerer, Master of Possession, and Chaos Apothecary, with constructive missing-host errors and one-external-Leader-per-host validation. Chaos Lord Glorious Jump Pack and Master of Possession Daemonic Jump Pack attachment overrides remain intentionally deferred until those paid loadout options exist. Replenished Ranks now sets the attached Legionaries root cost to 0; paid descendant costs will inherit the same association-aware zeroing during the loadout pass. Daemonkin now exempts the attached Possessed occurrence from normal Additional Copy Cost counting through association-aware surcharge refunds. Rare, Leader/Troop/Other, Infantry/Vehicle/Monster, Leader Capacity, Legion presentation, Legion availability, and normal ACC semantics were re-audited against the UUS.

REV4 — DAEMONKIN ACC RUNTIME FIX
Replaced the unproven roster-scope association-count query used by Daemonkin with a selection-count refund ladder. In this pre-loadout layer every Master of Possession must attach to Possessed, so each Master of Possession represents one exempt Possessed occurrence. The refund is capped by the number of copies that would otherwise incur Additional Copy Costs. Daemonic Jump Pack will require this exemption trigger to be refined when that option is implemented.

LAYER 0.4 — CHAOS LORDS / MASTER OF POSSESSION LOADOUTS REV5
Implemented loadouts for all four non-Terminator Legion Chaos Lords and Master of Possession. Chaos Lords use singular Lightning Claw in both mandatory weapon lists instead of a separate Lightning Claws replacement state. Glorious Jump Pack +20 and Daemonic Jump Pack +20 now switch required attachment targets to Raptors and Warp Talons respectively. Daemonkin is mode-aware: normal Masters of Possession exempt Possessed from Additional Copy Costs; Daemonic Jump Pack Masters exempt Warp Talons.

LAYER 0.5 — OLYMPIAN ARMOURY LEGIONARIES REV6
Added Iron Warriors-only Olympian Armoury Legionaries. The customizable fifth model appears first as Champion / Special Weapon / Heavy Weapon / Butcher. The remaining four models export as separate 4x Shrapnel Boltgun and 4x Combat Knife lines. Added Counts As: Legionaries to both Legionaries variants. Olympian Armoury Legionaries inherit Legionaries attachment eligibility, paid wargear, one-Leader host validation, and full Replenished Ranks zero-cost behavior.

REV7 — OLYMPIAN ROLE LABEL CLEANUP
Suppressed the redundant 'Champion / Special Weapon / Heavy Weapon / Butcher' wrapper label on Olympian Armoury Legionaries. The mandatory one-of-four role selector remains unchanged and now presents directly as Champion / Special Weapon Legionary / Heavy Weapon Legionary / Butcher Legionary.

LAYER 0.6 — IRON WARRIORS LOADOUTS / RULE CLEANUP REV8
Added complete loadouts for Tyrant Siege Terminators and Iron Circle Automata. Tyrant Siege Terminators are represented as two explicit models, each with separate Combi-Bolter and Tyrant Rocket Launcher lines and an independent Power Fist / Chainfist choice. Iron Circle Automata uses separate fixed lines for Olympia Bolt Cannon, Graviton Maul, and Kaceri Battle Shield. Removed non-attachment root rules from all Legion Chaos Lords, all Legion Terminator Chaos Lords, and Terminator Warsmith. Non-Terminator Chaos Lords retain only Leader Attachment at root; attachment-related paid Jump Pack rules remain on their paid options.

LAYER 0.7 — NEMESIS CLAW REV9
Implemented the full Nemesis Claw loadout with Visionary, one shared two-model default-loadout decision, and two explicit specialist models. The specialist models each choose Special Weapon, Heavy Weapon, or Nemesis Claw Butcher. Butcher options are Nostraman Chainglaive, Weird Claws, and Sorcerous Totem.

REV10 POLISH PASS
Applied the mature cross-faction listbuilder presentation standard to the loadouts already implemented through REV9 without expanding unfinished unit shells. Renamed the nine implemented Loadout groups to Loadout Options; added explicit model headers to the four Legion-specific Chaos Lords, Master of Possession, and Iron Circle Automata; split Master of Possession's fixed Bolt Pistol and Sorcerer Weapon into separate visible lines; converted the two Nemesis Claw 2-3 atomic default packages from '+' to '&'; and suppressed redundant one-item Glorious Jump Pack / Daemonic Jump Pack wrappers beneath Paid Wargear. Refreshed the live Chaos Lord, Master of Possession, and Additional Copy Costs authoring comments to describe their current implemented state. Standardized the eight external Leader host-limit errors and corrected plural grammar in the Tyrant Siege Terminators and Lernaean Terminators wrong-Legion errors. The Legion-specific Chaos Lord presentation, Olympian Armoury Legionaries compilation, Nemesis Claw specialist architecture and Nostraman Chainglaive convention, Lightning Claw convention, Daemonkin refund mechanics, Legion visibility, attachments, points, categories, Additional Copy Costs arithmetic, and every unfinished unit shell remain otherwise unchanged.

LAYER 0.8 — SIMPLE LOADOUT BATCH REV11
Implemented the first broad low-complexity loadout batch after the REV10 polish pass: Chaos Basilisk, Chaos Leviathan Dreadnought, Chaos Wardog, Chaos Vindicator, Chaos Predator, Master of Executions, Obliterators, Warp Talons, Chaos Defiler, Chaos Bikers, Chaos Rhino, Possessed, Warpsmith, Chaos Apothecary, Chaos Sorcerer, and Terminator Chaos Sorcerer Lord. Simplified Nemesis Claw 2-3 to two direct two-model package choices. Project conventions applied in this batch: Chaos Basilisk uses Hull Heavy Bolter / Hull Heavy Flamer naming; Chaos Leviathan Dreadnought and Chaos Wardog treat 'any two' as two independent choices that may select the same weapon twice; Chaos Wardog's paid auxiliary weapon is presented under Pintle Weapons despite its shoulder mounting; each Obliterator is represented as carrying all three Fleshmetal Armoury weapons simultaneously; and the Chaos Sorcerers present their mandatory allegiance choice under Paid Wargear > Psychic Discipline, with Undivided renamed Discipline of Chaos Undivided. Existing Legion logic, Leader attachments, Rare validation, Replenished Ranks, Daemonkin, Additional Copy Costs, points, categories, and all previously implemented loadouts remain otherwise unchanged.

REV12 — SIMPLE LOADOUT PRESENTATION CLEANUP
Corrected the psychic allegiance label to Disciple of Chaos Undivided for both Chaos Sorcerer variants. Suppressed the Chaos Rhino Main Weapon header. Collapsed Obliterators to a single semantic Obliterator Weapons line because their three Fleshmetal Armoury profiles are an in-game state rather than list-building equipment. Chaos Predator now presents its free auxiliary choice directly with no Additional Weapon header or (None), defaults to Storm Bolter by project convention, and intentionally uses the Storm Bolter player-facing name instead of the source Combi-Bolter. Suppressed the Chaos Leviathan Dreadnought Primary Weapons and Secondary Weapon labels while preserving its two independent duplicate-capable 'any two' selectors and separate secondary choice. All existing IDs and prior mechanics remain unchanged except for the deliberate Predator min-1 presentation constraint required to remove the empty option.

AUTHORING PATTERN — ONE PLAYER CHOICE, MULTIPLE SEMANTIC ITEMS
When one player-facing listbuilder option represents several underlying items, make the combined package the visible parent SelectionEntry (for example, '2x Bolt Pistol & 2x Chainsword'). Put each underlying semantic item beneath that parent in its own child SelectionEntryGroup, normally as a required min-1/max-1 group with a single default SelectionEntry such as '2x Bolt Pistol' and '2x Chainsword'. This lets New Recruit present one clean player decision while the catalogue still retains distinct internal items that can be referenced independently. Use zero-width child groups when those semantic items should still export as separate lines. Only hide the child groups/entries when the combined package must be the sole visible/exported line and that static-hidden/default behavior has been tested in New Recruit. Never use a selected-then-hidden transition for this pattern. Preserve the visible parent as the actual player choice; the children are implementation payload, not additional decisions.

LAYER 0.9 — TERMINATOR CHAOS LORDS / CHAOS ALLEGIANCE REV13
Collapsed Chaos Sorcerer and Terminator Chaos Sorcerer Lord psychic allegiance presentation from Paid Wargear > Psychic Discipline to the direct top-level Chaos Allegiance selector while preserving the existing allegiance option IDs and the old Psychic Discipline group IDs as hidden compatibility objects. Implemented complete loadouts for the four presentation-specific Legion Terminator Chaos Lords. As with the non-Terminator Chaos Lords, the paired Lightning Claw replacement is intentionally not presented as a separate option: singular Lightning Claw appears in both mandatory equipment lists, and selecting it in both represents the paired-claw state. Added a durable catalogue-level authoring note documenting the one-visible-choice / multiple-semantic-child-items pattern. Existing Legion availability, Champion of Chaos behavior, points, categories, wrong-Legion validation, Game System revision, and all previously implemented loadouts and rules semantics remain unchanged.

LAYER 1.0 — CHOSEN / SANDVICHES LUNCHBOX REV14
Implemented Chosen with a mutually exclusive Pack your lunch? presentation fork. No, I'll do it myself is the default and exposes the full manual 3-5-model builder: Chosen 1-2 include the paid Combi-Bolter replacement packages, Chosen 3-5 use the normal ranged list, Chosen 4-5 cost +40 Points each, every model has an independent melee list, and Frag/Krak Grenades remain independent +10 Paid Wargear. Per project convention, Lightning Claw is available in every ranged list as well as every melee list so paired claws are represented by selecting the same weapon in both lists without a separate Lightning Claws option or a one-model restriction. Yes, please! is a five-model easter-egg preset for Sandviches and adds the two extra models as +80 Points while presenting Chosen 1-5 with 5x Power Sword and 5x Plasma Pistol. All existing root Chosen categories, Leader-host semantics, Additional Copy Costs behavior, points outside the chosen branch, and all previously implemented units remain unchanged.

LAYER 1.1 — LEGIONARIES REV15
Implemented the five-model Legionaries loadout using the mature companion-listbuilder presentation. Chaos Champion is explicit with separate mandatory melee and pistol choices. Legionary 2-3 share a single two-model package selector whose visible options are 2x Boltgun & Combat Knife or 2x Chainsword & Bolt Pistol, with hidden semantic weapon children beneath each package. Legionary 4 and Legionary 5 are explicit specialist-role models that each choose Special Weapon Legionary, Heavy Weapon Legionary, or Butcher Legionary; special/heavy roles retain Combat Knife and select their source weapon, while Butcher carries Combat Knife and Heavy Chain Axe. The source's optional +10 Chaos dedication is presented as top-level Chaos Influence with Khornate Bloodlust, Tzeentian Sorcery, Nurglite Contagion, or Slaaneshi Grace. Replenished Ranks association-aware zero-cost behavior is applied to those paid descendant options as required by the existing Legionaries cost contract. Root points, Troop/Infantry categories, Counts Toward Troop semantics, Leader-host categories, host-limit validation, Additional Copy Costs behavior, and all previously implemented units remain unchanged.

LAYER 1.2 — CULTISTS REV16
Implemented the fixed ten-model Cultists loadout. Cultist Champion carries Bolt Pistol and Assault Weapon; Cultists 2-9 are aggregated as 8x Assault Weapon and 8x Autopistol; Cultist 10 defaults to the single visible Assault Weapon & Autopistol package with hidden semantic child equipment and may instead take Heavy Stubber for +10 Points. Frag Grenades and Krak Grenades are independent +10 Paid Wargear choices. Root cost, Troop/Infantry categories, Chaos Lord and Chaos Sorcerer host categories, attached-Leader validation, and all previously implemented units remain unchanged.

LAYER 1.3 — CHAOS TERMINATORS REV17
Implemented Chaos Terminators as two explicit independent model records with three battlefield-role branches each. Combi-weapon Terminators carry one melee selection and one Combi package; Heavy Weapon Terminators carry one melee selection and Reaper Autocannon / Heavy Flamer; Assault Terminators carry two independent melee selections. The Lightning Claw convention is reused: paired claws are represented by Lightning Claw in both melee lists rather than a separate Lightning Claws option. For listbuilder purposes both Terminators may select identical roles and identical equipment even where the PDF uses one-model replacement language. Cyclone Missiles remains a single +20 unit-level Paid Wargear choice with no listbuilder bearer assignment. Root points, Heavy Armour / Infantry categories, Other copy-cost behavior, and all previously implemented units remain unchanged.

LAYER 1.4 — ALPHA LEGION COMPILED UNITS REV18
Added Power Knife Legionaries as an Alpha Legion-only player-facing compilation of the Legionaries datasheet under Quiet Killers / Power Knives. Four models are fixed as 4x Bolt Pistol and 4x Power Knife while the remaining model is presented first as Champion, Special Weapon Legionary, Heavy Weapon Legionary, or Butcher Legionary. The unit Counts As: Legionaries and inherits Troop counting, Leader-host eligibility, Replenished Ranks, and optional Chaos Influence. Implemented Lernaean Terminators using the same two-model Combi-weapon / Heavy Weapon / Assault role architecture as Chaos Terminators, with Volkite Charger and the additional Alpha Legion heavy guns included. The Lightning Claw convention is reused and both Lernaean models may use identical roles/loadouts for listbuilder purposes. Existing Alpha Legion visibility/error logic, points, categories, Game System revision, and all previously implemented units remain otherwise unchanged.

LAYER 1.5 — HELBRUTE / DREADNOUGHT / CONTEMPTOR REV19
Implemented Chaos Helbrute and Chaos Dreadnought with two asymmetric anonymous weapon selectors, preserving the source equipment pools while suppressing physical left/right arm labels. Fist + auxiliary states are presented as single visible packages with hidden semantic component items. Chaos Dreadnought also receives Venerable as a +10 Unit Upgrade. Implemented Chaos Contemptor Dreadnought with two identical simplified weapon selectors: normal guns, Heavy Conversion Beamer, and Chainfist packages may duplicate freely; Chainfist & / Power Fist & reveal nested auxiliary choices including Combi-Bolter, Graviton Gun, Heavy Flamer, Meltagun, and Plasma Blaster. Power Fist & is mutually exclusive across the two selectors via reciprocal cross-selector hiding, while the already-selected Power Fist remains visible. Cyclone Missiles is optional +10 Paid Wargear. Root costs, Other-copy accounting, categories, Game System revision, and all previously implemented units remain unchanged.
